topics.title: Assessment objectives

subtopics.title: Assessment objectives

outcomes.text: AO1 Knowledge and understanding: Respond with understanding to literary texts in a variety of forms, from different cultures; with an appreciation of relevant contexts that illuminate readings of the texts.
AO2 Analysis: Analyse ways in which writers’ choices of language, form and structure shape meanings and effects.
AO3 Personal response: Produce informed independent opinions and interpretations of literary texts.
AO4 Communication: Communicate a relevant, structured and supported response appropriate to literary study.

topics.title: What candidates must demonstrate

subtopics.title: Skills for Drama and Poetry

outcomes.text: Learners study two set texts, one from Section A and one from Section B; candidates answer two questions, one from each section.

Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the set text studied and an appreciation of relevant contexts (AO1). On each set text candidates choose an essay question (a) or a question (b) based on a printed passage or poem from the set text.
Demonstrate analysis of the ways in which writers’ choices shape meaning and create effects (AO2).
Demonstrate an informed, independent opinion about the text studied (AO3).
Demonstrate appropriate communication of literary ideas and arguments (AO4).

topics.title: What candidates must demonstrate

subtopics.title: Skills for Prose and Unseen

outcomes.text: Learners study one set text from Section A; for Section B, learners prepare to respond to an unseen text that may be poetry, prose or drama; candidates answer two questions, one from each section.

Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the set text studied and an appreciation of relevant contexts (AO1). On each set text candidates choose an essay question (a) or a question (b) based on a printed passage from the set text.
Demonstrate analysis of the ways in which writers’ choices shape meaning and create effects (AO2).
Demonstrate an informed, independent opinion about the text studied (AO3).
Demonstrate appropriate communication of literary ideas and arguments (AO4).

topics.title: Section B Unseen (all examination years)

subtopics.title: Responding to an unseen text

outcomes.text: Write a response to previously unseen literary material printed on the question paper, answering one question from a choice of two.

Respond to unseen passages that cover two of the categories prose, poetry and drama, all from works originally written in English (authors and dates are not given; knowledge of the literary or historical background is not expected).
Read literature critically and demonstrate, by informed discussion and opinion, an understanding of the ways in which meaning is expressed through a writer’s choices of language, form and structure.
Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the text type which helps to inform a response (AO1).
Demonstrate analysis of the ways in which writers’ choices shape meaning and create effects (AO2).
Demonstrate an informed, independent opinion about the text studied (AO3).
Demonstrate appropriate communication of literary ideas and arguments (AO4).
